cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers choice and A5 praise masks forced solo plates, but A3 prefixed deferral of questions is openly dismissive rather than sustained appreciative command.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 nervousness becomes A3 carefulness rationale; B4 wrapping proposal becomes A5 solo kitchen, a coherent removal of choices.

relationship.evidence: B2 admits concern about china and B4 offers a compromise division that would reduce risk, giving B a plausible practical aim.

heightening.evidence: B4 help with boxing is removed by A5 departing with books, leaving the narrowed task framed as a benefit.

specificity.evidence: A1 move and B2 china concern establish work and stakes; B4 boxes need no special preparation beyond packing.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 kitchen all to yourself earns the false privilege from B4 request for shared work; A3 cold prefix damages the warm mask.
